parameters.name: AppCode
parameters.description: The AppCode encoding of the application.

parameters.name: AppKey
parameters.description: The application key, used when calling APIs.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: Specify the page number to query. The default value is 1, and the starting value is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Specify the number of rows per page for paged query. The maximum value is 100, and the default value is 10.

parameters.name: Sort
parameters.description:
Sort order. The default value is desc. Options are asc and desc.

- asc: Sort by modification time in ascending order.

- desc: Sort by modification time in descending order.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: Specify object tags that apply to the rule. You can set multiple tags.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag value.

The value range of n is `[1, 20]`

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key.

The value range of n is `[1, 20]`
